import os

# Check current directory and any newly added files
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
files = os.listdir('.')
print("Files in CWD:", files)

# Quick search for any csv files
csvs = [f for f in files if f.lower().endswith('.csv')]
print("CSV files in CWD:", csvs)

# Also search common roots
target_found = []
for root in ['/tmp', '/home', '/root', '/workspace', '/data', '/mnt', '/content']:
    if os.path.isdir(root):
        for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
            for f in fn:
                if f.lower().endswith(('.csv', '.xlsx', '.xls', '.tsv', '.json')):
                    target_found.append(os.path.join(dp, f))
print("Any tabular files found:", target_found if target_found else "None")
